description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerMenuConfigurator class responsible for configuring menu items for the Performance module in the OrangeHRM system. It implements the MenuConfigurator interface and utilizes traits for module and screen handling to override the screen for performance tracking.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class that configures the menu for Performance Tracker within the OrangeHRM system, overriding the default screen to 'viewPerformanceTracker'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen to 'viewPerformanceTracker' using the current module and screen helper, and returns null.
